$description: D-28 visual bug fix (TOKENS-THEME-05, release/4.x only): the 4.x theme-text primitives render rgba(0 0 0 / 0.9|0.7) in every scheme, so dark-scheme content ink sits black on navy. Each record names a frozen 4.x property (ag.legacyVar) and aliases the 5.0 sys colour pair whose dark value replaces it in the dark compat block (dark on-surface L >= 0.92, C <= 0.02). Emitted only by scripts/tokens/build.mjs --platform bridge-4x into src/material/compat/tokens.css; never emitted on next.
